name: Gaffer Jacks
summary: In Auberdine, Wizbang Cranktoggle needs his lost gaffer jacks back. The gnome inventor tossed a box of hardware into the sea during his voyage from Ironforge, and anglers can search for it along Darkshore's coast.

sections.title: A Cluttered Mind in a Quiet Haven
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle crossed the Great Sea from Ironforge to find quiet in Darkshore. The gnome inventor drank too much on the voyage. Leaning over the rail in a drunken haze, he lost a crate of specialized metal parts called gaffer jacks in the water near Auberdine.

sections.title: Tuning the Stintle Pegs
sections.body: Wizbang says gaffer jacks are essential precision tools. Without them, he cannot properly tune his stintle pegs or continue his delicate tinkering. Unwilling to wade into the cold surf himself, he asks local anglers to cast along Darkshore's shore and fish up the scattered parts.

faq.answer: Gaffer jacks are small gnomish mechanical fasteners and components. Wizbang Cranktoggle says he needs them to tune his stintle pegs.

faq.q: How did the gaffer jacks end up in the sea?
aliases: why are they in the water
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle drank too much during his voyage from the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor. While drunk aboard ship, he dropped his supply box overboard near Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine instead of Ironforge?
faq.answer: Wizbang went to Auberdine for its quiet. Ironforge's constant clatter and noisy workshops wore on him, especially while he nursed his hangovers.

faq.q: Where can the lost gaffer jacks be fished up?
aliases: where do i fish gaffer jacks
faq.answer: Anglers can fish the gaffer jacks from the open saltwater along Darkshore near Auberdine. They can turn up on ordinary casts, not only at schools of fish.

faq.q: What happens after recovering the gaffer jacks?
faq.answer: After Wizbang gets his gaffer jacks back to tune his pegs, he says he also lost his electropellers in Darkshore's rivers and lakes. Those must be fished out too.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang need adventurers instead of retrieving them himself?
faq.answer: Wizbang has a throbbing hangover and no sea angling gear. He stays dry on the Auberdine docks and leaves the dredging to anyone with a fishing rod.

angles.text: As a gnome, you know the restless eccentricity of tinkers. Wizbang's mix of delicate components and heavy drinking might make even you cringe.
As an engineer, you know how maddening it is to miss one unusual part needed to calibrate a delicate device.
As a night elf, you know Darkshore's woods are quiet and sacred. A loud, hungover gnome inventor is an odd sight for Auberdine's sentinels.
